text_post: wow there are 1000001 things that could go wrong here. - how does she know you? if you walk up to a random stranger and the first thing you ask them is 'do you want to come for a trip to my home town?' thats just weird - are you just friends? - do you have any attraction? - what have your past interactions been? - what is the subtext of what you are asking her? - what is the pre-text? ie what have you two done in the past that would make you think she wants to come with you? - were you creepy when you asked? - does she have a boyfriend? - do you smell? dude.... gotta be more specific than that. But my number one guess is: 'shes just not that into you...' go do some approaches, and invite another girl
